units.source_text: 夫人从正面的镜子里，看到自己的脸颊上飞起一片美丽的蔷薇色红潮。

en.t: In the mirror before her, the lady saw a beautiful rose-colored flush rise over her cheeks.

units.source_text: （干净宽敞的洁白理发店。

en.t: A clean, spacious, pure white barbershop.

units.source_text: 理发店内修指甲的化妆桌。

en.t: A manicure dressing table inside the barbershop.

units.source_text: 肌肤宛如动物闪亮的牙齿般的姑娘，正在给妇科医生修磨指甲。）

en.t: A girl whose skin was like the gleaming teeth of an animal was filing the gynecologist's nails.

units.source_text: 脑子里浮现出这些景象，夫人不由得喜气洋洋，脸颊上涌起一片温馨的幸福感。

en.t: As these scenes rose in her mind, the lady could not help becoming cheerful, and a warm sense of happiness welled up in her cheeks.

units.source_text: （清澄透明的水中浮现出美少年的臀部。

en.t: In the clear, transparent water, the beautiful boy's buttocks emerged.

units.source_text: 少年活像青蛙一样在游泳。）

en.t: The boy was swimming just like a frog.

units.source_text: 丈夫从房间里走了出来。

en.t: Her husband came out of the room.

units.source_text: （河岸上路过的学校老师，冲着学生们说：“孩子们！

en.t: A schoolteacher passing along the riverbank called out to the students, "Children!

units.source_text: 女孩子男孩子赤身裸体一起游泳，不成体统呀！”

en.t: Girls and boys swimming naked together is improper!"

units.source_text: 美少年游到岸边，爬上岸，笔直地站在草丛里，阳光照得他的臀部闪闪亮。

en.t: The beautiful boy swam to the bank, climbed ashore, and stood straight in the grass, sunlight making his buttocks shine.

units.source_text: 他说：“可是，老师，正由于我们一丝不挂，才丝毫分不清谁是男孩谁是女孩。”）

en.t: He said, "But teacher, precisely because we are wearing nothing at all, you cannot tell in the least who is a boy and who is a girl."

units.source_text: 夫人看到镜子里的自己，活像少女般腼腆。

en.t: Seeing herself in the mirror, the lady was shy like a young girl.

units.source_text: 她曾经是少女。

en.t: She had once been a young girl.

units.source_text: 这个少女如斯想。

en.t: This young girl thought in this way.

units.source_text: （话说得让老师笑逐颜开的少年真是个好孩子呀！

en.t: What a good child that boy was, saying something that made the teacher beam!

units.source_text: 曾是妇科医生的她父亲的诊疗室。

en.t: The consulting room of her father, who had been a gynecologist.

units.source_text: 手术台的洁白珐琅。

en.t: The pure white enamel of the operating table.

units.source_text: 腹部朝天的巨大青蛙。

en.t: A huge frog with its belly turned upward.

units.source_text: 诊疗室的门扉。

en.t: The door of the consulting room.

units.source_text: 门把手的洁白珐琅。

en.t: The pure white enamel of the doorknob.

units.source_text: 在门扉带有洁白珐琅把手的房间里，藏有秘密。

en.t: In the room whose door had a pure white enamel handle, a secret was hidden.

units.source_text: 至今我还那样感觉。

en.t: Even now I still feel that way.

units.source_text: 搪瓷的洗脸盆。

en.t: An enamel washbasin.

units.source_text: 她正想用手去触摸那洁白珐琅的把手，分布于一处处房间的门扉，蓦地使她踌躇起来。

en.t: Just as she was about to touch that pure white enamel handle with her hand, the doors set here and there among the rooms suddenly made her hesitate.

units.source_text: 洁白的窗帘。

en.t: Pure white curtains.

units.source_text: 在女校上学的时候，修学旅行的那天早晨，看见一个用洁白的搪瓷脸盆洗脸的同班女生，我顿时像男子似的爱上了她。

en.t: When I was attending girls' school, on the morning of a school trip, I saw a classmate washing her face in a pure white enamel basin, and at once I fell in love with her as though I were a man.

units.source_text: 理发师。

en.t: The barber.

units.source_text: 年幼的她躺在椅子上，一边让理发师给她修脸，一边目不转睛地仰望着他那白色的衣服。

en.t: As a little girl, she lay in the chair while the barber shaved her face, staring fixedly up at his white clothes.

units.source_text: 毛巾。

en.t: A towel.

units.source_text: 以往老师未曾从我们游泳的那条河的岸上路过。

en.t: In the past, teachers had never passed along the bank of the river where we swam.

units.source_text: 准是什么书上写了那种事吧。

en.t: That sort of thing must have been written in some book.

units.source_text: 东京也出现彩虹吗？

en.t: Do rainbows appear in Tokyo too?

units.source_text: 这面镜子里也映现彩虹吗？

en.t: Does a rainbow appear in this mirror too?

units.source_text: 孩提时的她站在彩虹映照下的小河岸上。

en.t: As a child, she stood on the bank of a little river where a rainbow was reflected.

units.source_text: 河流里穿梭着银针般的小鱼。

en.t: In the current, little fish like silver needles darted back and forth.

units.source_text: 秋风。

en.t: Autumn wind.

units.source_text: 孩提时的她望着那些鱼，觉得它们一定很寂寞。

en.t: As a child, she looked at those fish and thought they must be very lonely.

units.source_text: 据说古人以为老鼠出生于尼罗河、草叶上的露珠是昆虫的母亲、太阳照耀河泥会生出青蛙，等等。

en.t: It is said that ancient people believed mice were born from the Nile, that dew on blades of grass was the mother of insects, that sunlight shining on river mud produced frogs, and so on.

units.source_text: 雪。

en.t: Snow.

units.source_text: 蜡。

en.t: Wax.

units.source_text: 火。

en.t: Fire.

units.source_text: 烂泥。

en.t: Mud.

units.source_text: 希腊的亚里士多德完全知道单性生殖。

en.t: Aristotle of Greece knew all about parthenogenesis.

units.source_text: 据说雄蜂就是未经受精的卵子生出来的。

en.t: It is said that male bees are born from unfertilized eggs.

units.source_text: 交尾飞行。

en.t: Mating flight.

units.source_text: 婚礼仪式——华烛之典。

en.t: The wedding ceremony, the rite of bridal candles.

units.source_text: 新婚歌曲——洞房诗。

en.t: A newlywed song, a bridal chamber poem.

units.source_text: 婚床。

en.t: The marriage bed.

units.source_text: 她的赤足踩坏了丈夫的近视眼镜。

en.t: Her bare foot crushed her husband's nearsighted spectacles.

units.source_text: 婚床——新枕。

en.t: The marriage bed, the first shared pillow.

units.source_text: 交尾飞行——求婚飞翔。

en.t: Mating flight, courtship flight.

units.source_text: 仙女羽衣。

en.t: A heavenly maiden's feather robe.

units.source_text: 天使的纯洁。

en.t: The purity of angels.

units.source_text: 圣母马利亚哟，由于先生的研究，耶稣的诞生也被证明是科学的，圣母马利亚哟，天主教的大主教正在拜访卡尔·冯·西博尔德教授。

en.t: O Virgin Mary, through the professor's research even the birth of Jesus has been proved scientific; O Virgin Mary, a Catholic archbishop is visiting Professor Karl von Siebold.

units.source_text: 天主教的纯洁。

en.t: Catholic purity.

units.source_text: 在她故乡的古老海港教堂里，圣母马利亚——本是可爱的我，打算忏悔些什么呢？

en.t: In the old harbor church of her hometown, Virgin Mary, what was I, who was truly lovable, intending to confess?

units.source_text: 全都忘得一干二净啦。

en.t: I have forgotten absolutely everything.

units.source_text: 重力、杠杆、秤、惯性、摩擦、钟摆和钟、泵。

en.t: Gravity, levers, scales, inertia, friction, pendulums and clocks, pumps.

units.source_text: 哟！

en.t: Oh!

units.source_text: 这是普通五年制中学第三学期的理科目录嘛。

en.t: Why, this is the science syllabus for the third term of an ordinary five-year middle school.

units.source_text: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德和十字架。

en.t: Sigmund Freud and the cross.

units.source_text: 不过，雌蜂王一生仅交尾一次，仅仅一次，在蜂房之外。

en.t: But the queen bee mates only once in her life, only once, outside the hive.

units.source_text: 在家庭之外。

en.t: Outside the household.

units.source_text: 一个蜂房里住着一只雌蜂王，约莫住着上百只雄蜂、两万只以上工蜂。

en.t: In one hive lives a single queen bee, along with roughly more than a hundred drones and over twenty thousand worker bees.

units.source_text: 春日里蜜蜂的振翅声。

en.t: The wingbeats of honeybees on a spring day.

units.source_text: 火车车轮的滚动声。

en.t: The rolling sound of train wheels.

units.source_text: 听起来就像吸量管、吸量管。

en.t: It sounds like pipettes, pipettes.

units.source_text: 宾馆里的白蚊帐。

en.t: The white mosquito net in the inn.

units.source_text: 不是春天，是夏天。

en.t: Not spring, but summer.

units.source_text: 蜜月旅行。

en.t: A honeymoon trip.

units.source_text: 恍若银色飞石般从天空中降落的小鸟。

en.t: A little bird falling from the sky like a silver flying stone.

units.source_text: 远古人相信天空的色彩会映照大海啊！

en.t: People of remote antiquity believed the color of the sky was reflected in the sea!

units.source_text: 据潜水员说，海底的色彩世界里，没有红色和黄色，白色的海贝看似浅蓝色，红色的动物看似黑色。

en.t: According to divers, in the world of colors under the sea there is no red or yellow; white shells look pale blue, and red animals look black.

units.source_text: 蓝色的光线能射入海水的深处：在法国的尼斯港能达到四百米、在意大利的那不勒斯湾能达到五百五十米、在东地中海能达到六百米。

en.t: Blue light can penetrate deep into seawater: four hundred meters in the harbor of Nice in France, five hundred fifty meters in Italy's Bay of Naples, and six hundred meters in the eastern Mediterranean.

units.source_text: 这是深海里寂寞的感光板的感觉呀。

en.t: This is the feeling of a lonely photosensitive plate in the deep sea.

units.source_text: 它是为了测量透明度而不断沉入海底的直径一尺的白色感光板。

en.t: It is a white photosensitive plate one foot in diameter, continually sinking toward the seabed to measure transparency.

units.source_text: 沉浸在天蓝色月光中的珐琅手术台。

en.t: An enamel operating table immersed in sky-blue moonlight.

units.source_text: 宛如月光倾泻般注入海底的放射虫的尸骸之雨。

en.t: A rain of radiolarian corpses pouring down to the seabed as though moonlight were streaming there.

units.source_text: 纵令它永无休止地在空中飘洒，人们甚至也无法感觉到这种轻飘的尸骸的雪白之雨，无声无息、昼夜不断地向海底倾注。

en.t: Even if it drifted endlessly through the air, people could not even sense this light snow-white rain of corpses, which silently pours toward the seabed day and night without ceasing.

units.source_text: 附在海底电缆上的白色尸骸告诉人们，沉积的比例是历经百年才积淀一尺。

en.t: The white corpses attached to undersea cables tell people that the rate of accumulation is only one foot in a hundred years.

units.source_text: 昔日的海底，如今是白垩质的山。

en.t: What was once the seabed is now a chalky mountain.

units.source_text: 英国南部的多佛白崖。

en.t: The white cliffs of Dover in southern England.

units.source_text: 遥远时间的流程。

en.t: The flow of distant time.

units.source_text: 粉笔。

en.t: Chalk.

units.source_text: 女子中学黑板上画的花朵。

en.t: Flowers drawn on the blackboard of a girls' middle school.

units.source_text: 短命的少女。

en.t: A short-lived young girl.

units.source_text: 水平线上的白帆。

en.t: A white sail on the horizon.

units.source_text: 宾馆炸鱼那鱼眼的水晶体。

en.t: The lens of the eye of the fried fish at the inn.

units.source_text: 可怜啊，鱼是重度近视眼呢。

en.t: Poor things, fish are terribly nearsighted.

units.source_text: 形同西餐叉子的妇产科手术器械。

en.t: Obstetric and gynecological surgical instruments shaped like Western dinner forks.

units.source_text: 宛如白蚊帐的、睡帽一般的放射虫骨骼放大图的漂亮网眼。

en.t: The beautiful mesh in an enlarged image of a radiolarian skeleton, like a white mosquito net, like a nightcap.

units.source_text: 如同鱼嘴、鱼唇，没有味道的新婚同床之日。

en.t: The tasteless day of sharing the newlywed bed, like a fish's mouth, a fish's lips.

units.source_text: 交尾飞行。

en.t: Mating flight.

units.source_text: 就是这样的嘛。

en.t: That is how it is.

units.source_text: 新婚之日，我偶然激起空虚寂寞之感，带着这种心情，在类似意大利的那不勒斯湾的海岸山丘上漫步，在蜜蜂的振翅声中醒来。

en.t: On my wedding day, I happened to be seized by a hollow loneliness, and with that feeling I walked on coastal hills like those by Italy's Bay of Naples and awoke amid the wingbeats of bees.

units.source_text: 交尾飞行。

en.t: Mating flight.

units.source_text: 雌蜂王朝着春天晴朗的天空作求婚的飞翔。

en.t: The queen bee makes her courtship flight toward the clear spring sky.

units.source_text: 成群的雄蜂陪伴着她。

en.t: Swarms of drones accompany her.

units.source_text: 这群雄蜂中，唯有一只雄蜂，被雌蜂王爱上这唯一的一次。

en.t: Among this swarm of drones, only one is loved by the queen bee in this one and only time.

units.source_text: 雌蜂王的受精囊。

en.t: The queen bee's spermatheca.

units.source_text: 她生雌蜂还是生雄蜂，任她随心所欲。

en.t: Whether she gives birth to female bees or male bees is entirely as she wishes.

units.source_text: 生雄的或是生雌的产房不一样。

en.t: The birthing cells for males and females are different.

units.source_text: 在蜂王房和工蜂房排出的受精卵，就是雌的；在雄蜂房排出的未受精卵，就是雄的。

en.t: The fertilized eggs laid in queen cells and worker cells become females; the unfertilized eggs laid in drone cells become males.

units.source_text: 倘若受精囊的精子不输送给输卵管，那就是单性生殖。

en.t: If the sperm in the spermatheca is not sent to the oviduct, that is parthenogenesis.

units.source_text: 栖息在雌性的消化器官里，待到生殖的时候移动到输卵管里去的雄性绿叉嗌。

en.t: The male green worm that lives in the female's digestive organs and, when it is time to reproduce, moves into the oviduct.

units.source_text: 小小的可爱的丈夫。

en.t: A tiny, dear husband.

units.source_text: 一辈子连续不断地交尾的日本血吸虫。

en.t: The Japanese blood fluke, mating continuously throughout its life.

units.source_text: 躯体的一半是雄性，一半是雌性，或者三分之二是雄性，三分之一是雌性，或者由雄性变成雌性，或者由雌性变成雄性的舞毒蛾。

en.t: The gypsy moth whose body may be half male and half female, or two-thirds male and one-third female, or may change from male to female, or from female to male.

units.source_text: 幼小时是雄性，长大后变成雌性的海鞘和盲鳗。

en.t: Sea squirts and hagfish that are male when young and become female after growing up.

units.source_text: 哟！

en.t: Oh!

units.source_text: 记住这些东西，本想在谈话中不时可作比喻用，却全都给忘了呀！

en.t: I memorized these things, intending to use them now and then as metaphors in conversation, but I have forgotten them all!

units.source_text: 作什么比喻呢？

en.t: Metaphors for what?

units.source_text: 中河与一的小说描写信鸽传递种马精子的过程，写得多么美啊！

en.t: How beautifully Yoichi Nakagawa's novel describes the process by which carrier pigeons transport a stud horse's semen!

units.source_text: 交尾飞行，在空中翱翔的结婚哟。

en.t: Mating flight, a marriage soaring through the air.

units.source_text: 百米自由泳，五十八秒六，一九二二年，韦斯慕勒的世界纪录；一分二十五秒四，一九二四年，永井花子的日本女子纪录。

en.t: One hundred meter freestyle, fifty-eight point six seconds, Weissmuller's world record in 1922; one minute twenty-five point four seconds, Hanako Nagai's Japanese women's record in 1924.

units.source_text: 多么令人怀念的少女时代呀！

en.t: What a nostalgic girlhood!

units.source_text: 一分钟三千六百微米。

en.t: Three thousand six hundred micrometers per minute.

units.source_text: 噢，这是人类精子游动的速度。

en.t: Oh, this is the swimming speed of human sperm.

units.source_text: 从自身体积的大小比例来看，据说与世界一流的游泳选手的速度相当呢。

en.t: Judged in proportion to its own body size, it is said to match the speed of a world-class swimmer.

units.source_text: 银子般的鱼。

en.t: Fish like silver.

units.source_text: 矛。

en.t: A spear.

units.source_text: 蝌蚪。

en.t: A tadpole.

units.source_text: 拖着线的胶皮气球。

en.t: A rubber balloon trailing a string.

units.source_text: 十字架和弗洛伊德。

en.t: The cross and Freud.

units.source_text: 什么是比喻？

en.t: What is a metaphor?

units.source_text: 所谓象征当真是多么可悲的东西啊！

en.t: How truly sad a thing symbolism is!

units.source_text: 近视的鱼眼睛的水晶体。

en.t: The lens of a nearsighted fish's eye.

units.source_text: 水晶球。

en.t: A crystal ball.

units.source_text: 玻璃。

en.t: Glass.

units.source_text: 凝望着巨大水晶球的是印度、土耳其、埃及吗？

en.t: Is it India, Turkey, or Egypt gazing into the enormous crystal ball?

units.source_text: 东方的预言家。

en.t: Prophets of the East.

units.source_text: 水晶球里浮现出宛如小模型的过去与未来形象的电影画面。

en.t: Movie images of past and future forms, like little models, appear in the crystal ball.

units.source_text: 水晶幻想。

en.t: Crystal fantasy.

units.source_text: 玻璃幻想。

en.t: Glass fantasy.

units.source_text: 秋风。

en.t: Autumn wind.

units.source_text: 天空。

en.t: The sky.

units.source_text: 海洋。

en.t: The sea.

units.source_text: 镜子。

en.t: The mirror.

units.source_text: 啊！

en.t: Ah!

units.source_text: 从这面镜子里能听见呀。

en.t: It can be heard from inside this mirror.

units.source_text: 那无声的声音。

en.t: That soundless voice.

units.source_text: 宛如无声的雪花般降落海底的白色尸骸之雨。

en.t: A rain of white corpses falling to the seabed like soundless snowflakes.

units.source_text: 倾注到人类内心的死亡本能的声音。

en.t: The voice of the death instinct pouring into the human heart.

units.source_text: 感光板在海里的感觉。

en.t: The sensation of a photosensitive plate in the sea.

units.source_text: 这面镜子恍如一块银板，闪烁着亮光逐渐沉入海底。

en.t: This mirror is like a silver plate, flashing with light as it gradually sinks to the seabed.

units.source_text: 能看得见这面镜子渐渐沉入我心灵的海洋。

en.t: I can see this mirror gradually sinking into the ocean of my heart.

units.source_text: 烟雾朦胧之夜，蓝色的月光普照远方，呈现一小片银色。

en.t: On a smoky, hazy night, blue moonlight shines far into the distance, revealing a small patch of silver.

units.source_text: 我爱这面镜子。

en.t: I love this mirror.

units.source_text: 莫非我最终会变成这可怜的镜子？！）

en.t: Could it be that in the end I will become this poor mirror?!

units.source_text: 夫人用口红描抹着上唇，在这牡丹色唇膏色彩的映衬下，她没有察觉自己的脸颊逐渐变得苍白。

en.t: The lady traced and filled in her upper lip with lipstick; against the peony color of the lipstick, she did not notice her cheeks gradually growing pale.

units.source_text: 倘使这面新镜子改变了夫人的化妆方法，那是因为她在思考，胚胎学里也有对生下私生子的女人有利的学说。

en.t: If this new mirror changed the lady's way of applying makeup, it was because she was thinking that embryology too contained theories favorable to women who bore illegitimate children.

units.source_text: 但是，夫人这种想法其实起到了把另一种惊人的想法封存在心底的作用。

en.t: But this thought of the lady's in fact served to seal another astonishing thought deep within her heart.

units.source_text: （吸量管、吸量管。

en.t: Pipette, pipette.

units.source_text: 只有丈夫才知道此后吸量管内的将是什么液体。

en.t: Only her husband knew what liquid would be in the pipette after this.

units.source_text: 万一是其他动物的……哦？

en.t: What if it belonged to another animal... oh?

units.source_text: 自古以来，在这个世界上只有两个女人遭受这种耻辱吗？）

en.t: Since ancient times, have only two women in this world suffered such humiliation?

units.source_text: 夫人宛如关闭冰门似的，把映现出温室式玻璃屋顶的左侧那面镜子紧紧地关上。

en.t: As though shutting an ice door, the lady tightly closed the mirror on the left, which reflected the greenhouse-like glass roof.
